''See also: [[Reader (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Readers]] are individuals possessing specialized sensory abilities that allow them to perceive [[Intent]]. This skill can be used for various purposes, such as investigating the history of artifacts, uncovering the truth behind crimes, or understanding foreign languages by interpreting the meaning behind spoken words. While common people often view them as superhuman, their abilities are distinct from ordinary human perception. The highest tier of this discipline is found in the [[Soulbound]], elite warriors who utilize advanced [[Reading]] to perform miraculous feats and access the powers of [[Kameira]] through a [[Vessel]]. However, the practice of [[Reading]] carries significant risks. Attempting to contact or observe [[Great Elders]] directly can lead to madness, and even interacting with lesser [[Elderspawn]] can be disorienting. A condition known as [[Reader burn]] occurs when an individual's abilities exceed their physical constitution. Furthermore, interacting with powerful [[Imperial relics]] or the overwhelming [[Intent]] of a strong Reader can be dangerous to one's mental stability and identity. Historically, the Emperor was a legendary Reader who utilized specialized techniques to combat certain [[Elderspawn]] and used an artifact called the [[Optasia]] to amplify his talents. Because [[Readers]] possess unique experiences that others must take on faith, organizations exist to monitor and verify their accuracy. The role of a Reader is central to The Empire{{!}}the Empire's survival, as they are trained to study [[Elders]] to defend against them and assist Navigators in traversing the [[Aion]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Readers]] perform Readings to sense [[Intent]] through the air and can use the [[Optasia]] to magnify their talents. They possess the power to cancel out [[Intent]], investigate the history of artifacts, and experience vivid visions of other locations. Some practitioners also choose to blind themselves to increase their clarity when sensing [[Intent]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Abilities and Talents}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A Reader is an individual capable of performing the act of [[Reading]], which involves using the [[Optasia]] to magnify their inherent talents.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 13</ref> Through this ability, they can experience vivid visions of distant locations and perform Readings to sense [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" /><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c11">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 11</ref> These individuals can utilize their skills to investigate the history of an artifact or uncover the truth behind a crime.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref> While a Reader from the [[Imperial Prisons]] was once utilized to test the [[Optasia]], some practitioners follow a custom of blinding themselves to achieve a clearer sense of [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c18">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 18</ref><ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c22">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 22</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A Reader is someone who can use the [[Optasia]] to magnify their talents.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Readers]] can experience vivid visions of other places.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A Reader is someone who can perform Readings to sense [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c11" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Readers]] are individuals who can perform the act of [[Reading]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|A Reader can investigate the truth of a crime or the history of an artifact.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14" />}}</li>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Awakening process}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|To operate at the level of the [[Regents]], a Reader must possess an understanding of full capabilities, though [[Tyria]] does not hold this role.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref> While no sane Reader would bother to examine the iron-and-crystal manacles{{!}}manacles closely, a Reader serves as one of the three essential sources of [[Intent]] during the [[Awakening]] process.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref> A Reader is required to verify the identity of [[Calder]], yet they are instructed to avoid looking at the [[Elders]], particularly when using a looking-glass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref> [[Calder]] relies on intuition rather than his Reader powers to sense [[Loreli]]'s intentions, especially since a Reader can be deceived if someone controls their [[Intent]] to hide memories.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A Reader is needed who understands full capabilities and can operate on the level of the [[Regents]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Tyria]] is not a Reader.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|No Reader in their right mind would examine the iron-and-crystal manacles{{!}}manacles closely.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Reader is one of the three sources of [[Intent]] in the [[Awakening]] process.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A Reader is needed to verify [[Calder]]'s identity.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Readers]] are taught not to look at the [[Elders]], especially with a looking-glass.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Calder]] senses [[Loreli]]'s intentions through intuition rather than his power as a Reader.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A Reader can be deceived by controlling one's [[Intent]] to hide memories.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“This is Guild business, Calder. Certainly, we can always use more Readers, but we haven’t fallen so low as to recruit...men as young as yourself.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“The boy’s right,” Foster said. “First thing they teach you as a Reader: don’t look at the Elders. Especially not with a looking-glass pressed right against them.”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21" />}}
